test_title: PYST 1: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the underlined part of the sentence. If the sentence is already correct, select 'No substitution required'.

One of the most valuable paintings __**were stolen**__ from the gallery last night.
solution:
The correct answer is '**was stolen**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 
 
• The subject of the sentence, "**One of the most valuable paintings**," is singular. 
 
• The verb "**were stolen**" is incorrect because "**were**" is used for plural subjects. 
 
• The correct verb is "**was stolen**" to match the singular subject. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**. 
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"One of the most valuable paintings **was stolen**__ from the gallery last night."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 
 
 
• **Option 2: "have stolen"** is incorrect because "have" implies a present perfect tense, which doesn’t fit the context of "last night." 
 
• **Option 3: "had stolen"** is incorrect because it implies past perfect tense, which requires another past action for context. 
 
• **Option 4: "No substitution required"** is incorrect because the sentence contains a grammatical error.
